About Analytics Report

About WebPerformance Report

WebPerformance Report is a reporting service. It gathers data from the tools you already trust and turns it into a clear report delivered to your inbox, on your schedule. Free to start, no dashboard to keep checking.

The Google Analytics 4 Report shows the numbers from your GA4 property next to the previous period: audience and traffic, device category, countries, acquisition channels and top pages, so a drop shows up while you can still act on it.

See the analytics report

Where the data comes from

Google Analytics is the most widely used analytics platform on the web, and for most teams it is where their traffic numbers come from. GA4 is its current generation, built on an event-based model that measures websites and apps together.

The standard version is free and connects with Google Ads, Search Console and BigQuery.

Explore Google Analytics 4

Inside the Web Analytics Report

A traffic drop rarely announces itself: a channel dries up, a market cools or a page loses its audience, and it can take weeks before anyone notices. Every report shows your numbers next to the previous period across the five areas below, so you can see what moved and where to look first.

  • Summary

    Active users, new users, sessions and views, each with the change against the previous period.

  • Device category

    How your audience splits between desktop and mobile, and whether one is growing while the other falls.

  • Country

    Where your visitors are, with users, sessions and views per country, so you can see which markets are growing.

  • Channel

    Which channels bring people in, direct, referral, organic search and more, and which ones are slipping.

  • Pages

    Your top pages by users, sessions and views, so you can tell which content is working and which is losing its audience.
